description: Source code for a byte buffer implementation, including memory pooling, buffer manipulation, and related utilities.

classes.name: default_segment_pool_memory_resource
classes.description: Memory resource wrapper for the default byte buffer segment pool, handling allocation and deallocation.

classes.name: default_fallback_segment_pool_memory_resource
classes.description: Memory resource wrapper that falls back to heap allocation when the pool is depleted.

classes.name: byte_buffer::control_block
classes.description: Internal control structure managing segments and memory for byte_buffer.

classes.name: byte_buffer
classes.description: Main class implementing a byte buffer with segment management, copying, resizing, and appending functionalities.

methods.name: byte_buffer::create
methods.description: Creates a new byte_buffer with a specified segment pool.

methods.name: byte_buffer::deep_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the byte_buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::append
methods.description: Appends data or another byte_buffer to the current buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::append_segment
methods.description: Adds a new segment at the end of the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::prepend_segment
methods.description: Adds a new segment at the beginning of the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::pop_last_segment
methods.description: Removes the last segment from the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to a new size, adding or removing segments as needed.

methods.name: byte_buffer::linearize
methods.description: Converts the buffer into a contiguous memory block if not already contiguous.

methods.name: make_byte_buffer
methods.description: Creates a byte_buffer from a hex string.

methods.name: to_span
methods.description: Converts a byte_buffer into a span of bytes, copying if necessary.
